inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Detection of LegionLoader - Decryption Attempt of drata.dat via 7-Zip in Traiolx Directory

properties.description: This detection monitors the execution of 7zG.exe—the 7-Zip GUI executable—specifically when launched from the Traiolx Custom Utils or Kilo Verfair Tools directory under the user’s Roaming profile (\\AppData\\Roaming\\Traiolx Custom Utils). It identifies suspicious command-line activity where 7zG.exe is used to decrypt or extract a file named drata.dat, used to load second payload.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Detection of LegionLoader - Decryption Attempt of drata.dat via 7-Zip in Traiolx Directory
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "7zG.exe" or ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName has "Igor Pavlov"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Traiolx Custom Utils", "Kilo Verfair Tools")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine
